title: AB Monitor
name: AB Monitor
description: A monitor controller inside LUNA: switch your mix between two pairs of speakers with one click, on any audio interface, no extra hardware. Mono, dim, a trim per pair so A and B play at the same level, and your speakers' names. One click also prepares a clean MIX folder, and Undo MIX puts everything back. Getting-started guide, 7 languages.
